title: chore(env): boot the Cloud Agent API and client from start
intent: The committed Cloud Agent config listed API and client processes under terminals and had no start script. Terminals are ignored unless start is also set, so a fresh agent never booted the dev servers. This patch keeps install idempotent, adds the OpenCV/WeasyPrint libraries the API image already installs, publishes a Node that satisfies the client engine floor, and starts the API on port 8010 (the Vite proxy target) plus the Vue dev server from start.
behavior_change: Cloud Agent boot now starts the API on port 8010 and the Vite client on port 5173 from .cursor/start.sh. Application routes, schemas, and manufacturing behavior are unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: .cursor/environment.json drops the terminals entries and sets start to bash .cursor/start.sh. .cursor/install.sh adds libgl, libglib, libxcb, and libpangoft2, and publishes Node 22.22.2 on /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin via /etc/profile.d so login shells do not pick an older node earlier on PATH. New .cursor/start.sh launches uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8010 and vite on 127.0.0.1:5173 in tmux, and skips a server that is already healthy. AGENTS.md records the ports, the Node PATH, and that sg-spec clones from a public git URL for this install.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No other file in the repo starts these two dev servers on agent boot. The previous terminals block never ran, because start was absent. README and the Makefile start the API on port 8000, which the Vite dev proxy does not use.

commands_run: bash -l .cursor/start.sh -> API ready :8010, client ready :5173, EXIT 0
Calculator hub at http://127.0.0.1:5173/calculators: String Tension Calculator updates total tension across Light, Medium, and Heavy gauge presets

files.intent: Boot the dev servers from start instead of an ignored terminals list.
